title: Bi-Lipschitz Absorption of c0 Without a Linear Copy of c0
summary: We construct a separable real Banach space Z that contains no linear copy of c 0 , yet is bi-Lipschitz equivalent to $`Z\oplus_\infty c_0`$. The same space contains a bi-Lipschitz image of every separable metric space.
family_title: Lipschitz equivalent Banach spaces need not be linearly isomorphic

review.reason: Constructs a Banach space bi-Lipschitz equivalent to a c0 sum yet containing no linear copy of c0.
